In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'' is set immediately after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a [[Guineo]] '''guard''' worked in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of [[Haugg Nerf Industries]] in the [[Industrial District/Legends|industrial district]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While the Guineo was still new to the job, a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] arrived that the worker assumed contained [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] meat. The guard's [[Draag]] [[Unidentified Draag supervisor|supervisor]] corrected the Guineo and stated that the shipment was of [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]]. However, when the Draag failed to find the speeder's owner, someone named [[Jervis Gloom|Gloom]], upon the vessel, the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] told the Guineo to watch over the speeder and left to inform the plant boss, [[Groff Haugg]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] then sprang upon the scene and stopped both the Guineo guard and the Draag boss.<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter" />
